items.title: SaaStr AI App of the Week: Chargebee. The Billing System Behind How Gorgias, CodeRabbit, Lambda and Zapier Price AI
items.snippet: Chargebee has been around 14+ years and runs billing for 6,500+ businesses. It makes the list this week because of what it shipped in 2026 and who is running on it. Every AI company we talk to has changed its pricing at least twice, usually from seats to credits, then to actions, then to outcomes.... Continue Reading
